pricing_check.name: pricing_check
pricing_check.value: ("offerings"."pricing_type" = 'FIXED' AND "offerings"."price_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "offerings"."price_minor" > 0) OR ("offerings"."pricing_type" = 'FREE' AND "offerings"."price_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "offerings"."price_minor" = 0) OR ("offerings"."pricing_type" = 'QUOTE' AND "offerings"."price_minor" IS NULL)
